name: roomcraft
description: 上传户型图 → AI 结构化 → 可编辑 3D 户型 + 风格效果图（MVP）

scripts.schema:codegen:py: uv run datamodel-codegen --input packages/shared-schema/floor-plan.schema.json --input-file-type jsonschema --output apps/server/app/plan/floor_plan_models.py --output-model-type pydantic_v2.BaseModel --use-schema-description --target-python-version 3.12
scripts.server:dev: uv sync --all-packages --quiet && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8787
scripts.server:lint: uv run ruff check apps/server spikes packages/shared-schema/schema_check.py
scripts.server:format: uv run ruff format apps/server spikes packages/shared-schema/schema_check.py
scripts.spike:a: uv sync --all-packages --quiet && uv run python -m spike_a
scripts.spike:b: uv sync --all-packages --quiet && uv run python -m spike_b
scripts.spike:smoke: pnpm spike:a --provider mock --limit 1 && pnpm spike:b --provider mock --scene spikes/samples/000_synth_smoke_electronic.png --style spikes/samples/000_synth_smoke_electronic.png --count 1
